pages.text: $(bold)Diary fragment:$()"The meaning of energy is not limited to machines. Pouring 10M Chi Energy into a Netherite Ingot, I obtained a$(2) Akaishi Ingot$() - its density far exceeds my imagination."$(br2)Akaishi equipment is the ultimate armament of Akaishi technology:$(li)Energy Aggregator: 10M Chi + 1 Netherite Ingot → 1 Akaishi Ingot$(li)Equipment Forger: Chi + Akaishi Ingot + Netherite equipment → Akaishi equipment$(li)Upgrade Station: spend Upgrade Templates and upgrade slots to strengthen gear

Akaishi equipment has $(bold)1.25x$() the armor and toughness of Netherite, and each piece starts with $(bold)4 upgrade slots$().$(br2)Don't forget to carry a$(bold) Portable Akaishi Energy Cell$() - while held, your equipment's durability repairs itself.
